subject: Alignment: Stage-gate MAP + Tranche pricing for Helix Health
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft Stage-gate MAP + Tranche proposal (Helix Health)

Priya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight stage-gate mutual action plan (MAP) and a tranche-based commercial proposal aligned to the evaluation milestones you outlined. High level:

- 3-stage evaluation (POC week, extended eval + performance gates, production ramp)
- Pricing in tranches tied to committed throughput and observability retention level
- Optional premium support bundle and one-off add-on credits for burst capacity

Attached: Helix_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones) and redwood_tranche_pricing_Q4_2026.xlsx (pricing scenarios).

Specific asks from you to finalize:
1) Confirmation of the target production date for ramp (we used 2027-02-01 as a placeholder)
2) Which observability retention tier you prefer (30d, 90d, 365d) — impacts bundle pricing
3) Any procurement timing constraints or PO terms we should reflect in the MAP

If helpful, Marcus can outline how the observability retention tradeoffs impact unit economics (tokens / month). Laura will be your commercial lead for contract/PO cadence.

Proposed next step: quick 30-min alignment call this Wednesday to lock milestone dates and commit bands.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Helix_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
Attachment: redwood_tranche_pricing_Q4_2026.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft Stage-gate MAP + Tranche proposal (Helix Health)

Olga —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear MAP file. A few clarifying questions from our side before we jump on a call:

- Observability retention: our security team prefers 90d as a baseline; 365d would require additional sign-off and budget. Can you send a short note on what data types are retained and how retention affects our monthly invoice?
- Tranche pricing: the spreadsheet lists three commit bands but we need to see an example monthly invoice for the mid-band (commit = 1.2M tokens/month) that includes observability and premium support.
- Credits: we plan for an initial pilot with bursts; will add-on credits expire?

Procurement note: our standard T&Cs require a 45-day payment term and a single PO per year. Also, any SOC-2 evidence for hosted API would be helpful for our auditors.

Can we do Wednesday 11/18 at 11am PST for the sync? Samir and I will join.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Sr. Product Manager — Data & Platforms
Helix Health
priya.shah@helixhealth.com

Subject: Re: Draft Stage-gate MAP + Tranche proposal (Helix Health)

Priya —

Great questions. Quick answers and numbers below; I put a short sample invoice + breakdown in the attached pricing workbook (redwood_tranche_pricing_Q4_2026.xlsx, tab: Mid-band example). Key points:

- Observability retention: 90d retains request/response metadata, per-route latency histograms, and token-level cost traces. We do not store raw prompt content unless you enable long-term logging (opt-in). 90d vs 30d increases observability cost ~+18% on the middle tranche in our model; 365d is ~+42%. Exact delta depends on traffic profile and sampling.
- Invoice example: mid-band (1.2M tokens/month) + 90d retention + Standard Support = $11,400/mo (token charges + observability line + support). Mid-band + Premium Support + 90d = $13,600/mo.
- Credits: Add-on credits (one-off) expire after 12 months; we can tier that to 6 months for pilot credits if you prefer.
- SOC 2: attaching a redacted SOC 2 report stub and a short security FAQ.

Suggested MAP adjustments (inline edits in Helix_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf):
- Gate 1 (POC, 2 weeks): success criteria = latency < 200ms p95 for targeted endpoints, model quality baseline (F1 >= 0.78 on supplied eval set)
- Gate 2 (extended eval, 4 weeks): ramp to 50% of mid-band traffic, performance hold + cost sanity check, sign-off from Security/Compliance
- Gate 3 (production ramp): commit band start at mid-band, with a 60-day option to escalate to high-band at pre-negotiated uplift (10%)

Happy to walk through the invoice example on the call.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: redwood_tranche_pricing_Q4_2026.xlsx (tab: Mid-band example)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft Stage-gate MAP + Tranche proposal (Helix Health)

Olga / Marcus —

Thanks — the level of detail is exactly what Procurement and Security wanted. Two quick confirmations before we sign:

1) We agree to the 3-stage MAP and the gate criteria as listed (we'll add a short legal rider re: data retention and deletion).
2) We'll take the mid-band commit with 90d observability and Premium Support for the pilot phase. Please set the pilot commit at 1.2M tokens/month and include 25k add-on burst credits (12-month expiry).

Procurement asked for DocuSign and a single-year PO for now. Can you send a DocuSign link with the adjusted commercial terms (mid-band + 90d + Premium + 25k credits) and the 45-day payment term? If you include the SOC-2 stub in the DocuSign package that would expedite review.

If you send the DocuSign today we'll aim to route the PO by 11/30. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Priya Shah
Sr. Product Manager — Data & Platforms
Helix Health
priya.shah@helixhealth.com
